newsitem.title: FRANCE: ONIC seen raising French 96/97 wheat export goal.
newsitem.headline: ONIC seen raising French 96/97 wheat export goal.

text.p: French cereals authority ONIC plans to raise its estimate for French 1996/97 soft wheat exports to non-EU countries by 250,000 tonnes, grain industry sources said on Friday.
ONIC also plans to increase its target for barley exports to non-EU countries in 1996/97 by 400,00 tonnes, they said
A draft ONIC report prepared for publication next Wednesday suggests France would export 6.25 million tonnes of soft wheat to non-EU countries in 1996/97, they said.
This would compare with 6.0 million tonnes forecast in December and 3.75 million exported in 1995/96.
The draft also suggests France would export 1.5 million tonnes of barley outside the European Union in 1996/97 against 1.1 million predicted last month and 221,000 tonnes in 1995/96.
ONIC may also raise its target for soft wheat exports to other European Union countries to 9.035 million tonnes from 8.940 million forecast last month and 8.613 million tonnes in 1995/96.
It may slightly increase its target for barley exports to other European Union partners to 2.26 milion tonnes from a previous target of 2.20 million and 2.244 million exported in 1995/96.
France would end the 1996/97 season with a soft wheat carryover of 2.185 million tonnes against 2.365 million forecast last month and 2.212 million in 1995/96.
The barley carryover may reach 1.115 million tonnes against 1.375 million forecast last month and 626,000 at end-June 1996.
The figures were drawn up at a meeting of ONIC industry advisers and may be adjusted before publication on February 12.
